status: exploratory; historical data have already been inspected; not a confirmatory holdout
scope: Isolated dynamic control-poisoning feasibility and honest-history diagnostic. No manuscript or canonical experimental code changes.
reference: count control with kappa=20; original NullModel and robust CUSUM
candidate: capped value control w(v)=min(v,0.1 BTC); cap fixed before this dynamic experiment
refits: 13-week global anchors from 2020-01-06, 104-week lookback, 13-week gap; 2019 uses the static fit
calibration: own fit-only dispersion and original 400-replicate 8-week block bootstrap, target ARL 104, paired seed 20261103
inventory: Existing ledger segments from address bucket 0 only; exactly one eligible segment per address overlapping the attack horizon, control p2pkh/p2sh, segment starts before onset and ends at/after horizon; at most 50000 lowest-value candidates, stable hash tie-break
inventory_filter_amendment: The initial across-all-history single-segment filter returned zero because natural age-band transitions create multiple segments for one output. Before examining any attack outcome, the filter was corrected to one segment overlapping the attack horizon. The first empty extraction is retained.
ownership: Counterfactual cooperation/ownership of the selected existing controls, never actual possession of their keys. This restricted address sample is not a global optimal adversary or a proved unique-key sample.
policy: Ascending value, then stable anonymous ID; spend an eligible whole output if remaining cumulative budget permits; each output at most once. Same plan for both controls.
causality: Add the control event in the attack week and remove its risk from the following week. Stable single-segment inventory has no original event, age-band transition or eligible linked-address output during this horizon. General cancellation is checked separately on toy paths.
uncertainty: Weighted variance is a working model, with fit-only batch inflation, not a confidence guarantee. Prior is recomputed causally. Compare frozen hazards and contaminated rolling refits separately.
